fs.write:
schema_version = 1
id = "record-names"
name = "Record names"
menu = "top"

[when]
extensions = ["txt"]

[run]
runtime = "command"
program = "/bin/sh"
confirm = true
args = ["-c", "printf '%s\\n' \"$$@\" >> '$environment/numbered-action'", "sh", "{paths}"]

schema_version = 1
id = "record-folder"
name = "Record folder"
menu = "top"

[when]
kinds = ["folder"]

[run]
runtime = "command"
program = "/bin/sh"
args = ["-c", "printf '%s\\n' \"$$STRATA_ACTION_SOURCE\" \"$$@\" >> '$environment/folder-action'", "sh", "{paths}"]

quality.note: Sole guard of the keyboard numbered-slot routes: semicolon then digit to the confirm dialog, and semicolon, period, digit on the focused folder with source background; dialog Cancel/Run shared with batch-rename-template-confirms; slot numbering unit-tested in services/actions, folder chord rows and rebinding in file_verbs::actions

message: Jobs to show the completed run
Escape to close the Jobs popover the run opened
Jobs to count the folder action's run as the second finished job
